$comment: THE MACHINE-READABLE CONTRACT. Written at definition, read by tools/gate.mjs.
Prose in KICKOFF.md explains the run. THIS file decides whether it is finished.
Every bar needs a command that prints JSON to stdout and a field to read from it.
A bar with no command is unmeasurable and must not be in the exit condition —
move it to notes and be honest that a human judges it.

coverage.$comment: INVARIANT 4. What varies, such that reviewing one instance proves nothing.

determinism.$comment: INVARIANT 3. Named sources of nondeterminism and how each is pinned.
determinism.probeShot: {{name of a shot capture.mjs can render — verify-harness captures it twice and demands zero difference}}

player.$comment: INVARIANT 5. The critic that plays. Denials are asserted at runtime.
player.success: {{what counts as succeeding, as a predicate a program can check}}

handicap.$comment: An agent with perfect recall solves what no human could. Hobble it.

anchors.$comment: INVARIANT 10. Frozen artifacts that must not drift when a critic is replaced.

bars.reference: {{the external thing this is compared against, blind}}

coupledCluster.$comment: INVARIANT 7. Worked SEQUENTIALLY by one owner. Naming this is mandatory.
coupledCluster.why: {{what mutual dependency makes parallel work fail here}}

notes.$comment: Things that matter but cannot be gated. Be honest here rather than inventing a number.
